critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py admin_get_users (lines 38-94): the health computation runs in a Python loop after the Mongo aggregation. For 46 users this is fine, but for >5k users this becomes O(N) Python work on every admin page-load. Consider moving the health derivation into the aggregation pipeline ($cond/$let) once user count crosses ~1k. Low priority for current scale.

routes/admin.py line 62: `logged_in = bool(user.get('first_login_at') or user.get('last_active'))` — `last_active` is mutated on EVERY authenticated request via middleware. So even a user who only opened the app once but never 'really' logged in (e.g. session restore from cached token) appears as logged_in=True. If the intent is 'has completed at least one full login', use `first_login_at` only. Cosmetic — current behaviour is reasonable but the field name is ambiguous.

routes/admin.py line 60: `verified = user.get('verification_status') == 'verified'` — but `pending_verification` and `under_review` are both treated as not-verified, which surfaces the user as yellow with 'KYC pendiente'. That's correct, but consider expanding the reason string to differentiate ('KYC en revisión' for under_review) for better admin UX.

AdminUsersPage.jsx line 75: tooltip flags grid only renders 4 of the 6 flags (omits must_change_password and suspended). The reasons list does mention them via the 'Cambio de contraseña pendiente' / 'Cuenta suspendida' strings, so the info is not lost — but a user expecting full flag visibility might miss them. Either (a) add 2 more grid cells, or (b) document that the grid is the abbreviated quick-glance view and the reasons list is the source of truth.
AdminUsersPage.jsx line 67: 'Cambio de contraseña' uses ñ char — but the backend reason string at admin.py:72 uses the same ñ. Consistent. Keep as-is.

Hover-card on red/yellow dots animates a continuous ping (line 41). On a page with 46 yellow dots the 46 simultaneous CSS animations cost ~3-5% CPU on low-end devices. Consider gating the ping animation to only red OR pausing it when the page is not focused (visibilitychange listener). Cosmetic perf.
